entry.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
entry.summary: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

entry.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
entry.summary: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

entry.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger
entry.summary: Elon Musk likes the idea but says he is not on either committee, which is made up of independent directors.

entry.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
entry.summary: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

entry.title: Mach9 raises $34M after pivoting to AI CAD software
entry.summary: The startup initially set out to build better, faster, and cheaper surveying hardware in 2021.

entry.title: Heat pump tech is 170 years old — Pascal thinks it’s time for an update
entry.summary: Refrigerants startup Pascal has a new take on heat pump and cooling tech using a sponge-like material that promises to be 20% more efficient.

entry.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
entry.summary: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

entry.title: Foursquare co-founder says equity holders saw no returns from the company’s acquisition
entry.summary: Foursquare raised $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, but its equity holders saw no returns from its final acquisition.

entry.title: Waymo starts offering rides at the Las Vegas airport
entry.summary: Pickups and dropoffs will happen at dedicated "autonomous vehicle zones" at Terminal 1 and Terminal 3.

entry.title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
entry.summary: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

entry.title: PHP armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
entry.summary: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.

entry.title: GM is giving OnStar an AI makeover
entry.summary: It's one of the biggest overhauls ever to the 30-year-old connected car product.

entry.title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation
entry.summary: Legal AI startup Legora announced Wednesday that it raised a $550 million Series E round, valuing it at $8.8 billion.

entry.title: The internet is having a very bad cybersecurity day
entry.summary: From AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities to flaws in Node.js and popular AI tool LiteLLM, cybersecurity teams have plenty to worry about this week.

entry.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
entry.summary: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

entry.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in case related to Cambridge Analytica scandal
entry.summary: The payout is related to a recent trial involving the social media giant that revolved around its data privacy practices.

entry.title: GM is betting compute and AI will help it compete with Chinese automakers
entry.summary: To compete with Tesla, Rivian, and a host of Chinese automakers, GM’s fourth-gen EV platform will roll out a new central computer and electrical architecture that will debut in 2028 in the Cadillac Escalade IQ.

entry.title: Automattic begins layoffs following board upheaval and executive departures
entry.summary: Automattic has begun laying off employees across multiple teams, including WordPress.com and its enterprise business, following a board shakeup and a series of executive departures. Sources say more cuts could follow as the company looks to improve its finances.

entry.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
entry.summary: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

entry.title: Tesla stars Optimus robot production in California as profit falls 43%
entry.summary: Tesla's revenue was flat and its expenses skyrocketed as it pressed the accelerator on its Optimus robots, AI, and autonomous driving.
